title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The programme Food and Nutrition Security through Equitable and Climate Smart Food Systems will work in Port Loko and Tonkolili North Western Province, Sierra Leone. It aims to contribute to Concern Sierra Leone's Food Systems for Food Security thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to ensure vulnerable households' resilience to food and nutrition insecurity is increased by strengthening food systems. The programme will support over 86,310 people living in extreme poor households including those headed by women, households with disabled members, out of school young people, pregnant and lactating women, and people living with HIV. This will be done through better and more inclusive community management of natural resources, adoption of inclusive climate smart food production practices, profitable marketing of foods and food products, and improved access to quality productive assets.OBJECTIVES: Strong market systems that work for the poor (access)OUTCOMES: Vulnerable Households Experience Increased Levels of Food and Nutrition Security by Engaging in Income Generation along Food Value Chains
